2610.08660.title: Evidence-Bound Reasoning: Neuro-Semantic Verification of Biomedical AI in Glioblastoma Radiogenomics
2610.08660.paper_summary: Background: Biomedical AI can generate plausible explanations without reliably verifying whether each statement is supported by patient-specific evidence. We developed a neuro-semantic verification framework that converts radiomic measurements into addressable evidence records and machine-checkable claims. Methods: UPenn-GBM radiomics were aligned with de novo CaPTk extraction from standardized MRI and expert-validated segmentations in an independent multicenter cohort. The shared space comprised 1,728 features from T1, T1GD, T2, and FLAIR MRI across three tumor regions. Reference-defined semantic states were derived from 611 UPenn cases. We evaluated cross-cohort transportability, model-linked provenance, deterministic verification, controlled predictive degradation, and an LLM claim-extraction pilot; MGMT prediction served only as a transport stress test. Results: Median semantic-state agreement was 0.786 (weighted kappa 0.709), ranging from 0.918 for morphologic to 0.252 for intensity features. The external evidence ledger contained 1,655 model-linked records for 331 patients. The verifier achieved 100% exact-set accuracy in a 6,620-claim corruption benchmark. In a 24-case pilot, GPT-5.6 Sol reproduced 72/72 prespecified atomic claims, and the frozen verifier recovered 24/24 expected conditions. During controlled degradation, ROC AUC declined from 0.899 to 0.500 while verification accuracy remained 1.000. External MGMT discrimination was weak (ROC AUC 0.543). Conclusions: Verifiability can be engineered and evaluated independently of predictive performance. LLMs may structure explanations, while final evidence-consistency checking remains deterministic.
2610.08660.paper_summary_zh: 背景：生物醫學人工智慧可以生成合理的解釋，但無法可靠地驗證每個陳述是否有患者特定的證據支持。我們開發了一個神經語義驗證框架，將放射組學測量轉換為可尋址的證據記錄和機器可檢查的主張。方法：UPenn-GBM的放射組學與來自標準化MRI和專家驗證分割的de novo CaPTk提取進行對齊，這些數據來自一個獨立的多中心隊列。共享空間包含來自三個腫瘤區域的1,728個特徵，這些特徵來自T1、T1GD、T2和FLAIR MRI。參考定義的語義狀態源自611個UPenn案例。我們評估了跨隊列的可轉運性、模型鏈接的來源、確定性驗證、受控預測降解，以及LLM主張提取的試點；MGMT預測僅作為一個運輸壓力測試。結果：中位語義狀態一致性為0.786（加權kappa 0.709），範圍從形態特徵的0.918到強度特徵的0.252。外部證據賬本包含331名患者的1,655個模型鏈接記錄。驗證器在6,620個主張的腐敗基準中達到100%的精確集準確率。在一個24案例的試點中，GPT-5.6 Sol重現了72/72個預先指定的原子主張，凍結的驗證器恢復了24/24個預期條件。在受控降解期間，ROC AUC從0.899下降到0.500，而驗證準確率保持在1.000。外部MGMT區分能力較弱（ROC AUC 0.543）。結論：可驗證性可以被設計並獨立於預測性能進行評估。LLM可能結構化解釋，而最終的證據一致性檢查仍然是確定性的。
